stem: Which list names all the countries of the United Kingdom?
options: England, Scotland, Wales and the Republic of Ireland
England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
explanation: The UK has four countries: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. The Republic of Ireland is a separate, independent country.
source: Handbook ch. 2 · What is the UK?

stem: Which countries together make up Great Britain?
options: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
explanation: Great Britain means England, Scotland and Wales. Adding Northern Ireland gives the United Kingdom.
source: Handbook ch. 2 · What is the UK?

stem: What is the full official name of the UK?
options: The Commonwealth of Great Britain and Ireland
The United Kingdom of England, Scotland and Wales
The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
The United Kingdom of the British Isles and Ireland
explanation: The official name includes both Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
source: Handbook ch. 2 · What is the UK?

stem: Northern Ireland is part of Great Britain.
explanation: Northern Ireland is part of the United Kingdom, but Great Britain means only England, Scotland and Wales.
source: Handbook ch. 2 · What is the UK?

stem: The Republic of Ireland is part of the United Kingdom.
explanation: The Republic of Ireland is an independent country. Only Northern Ireland, on the same island, is part of the UK.
source: Handbook ch. 2 · What is the UK?
